notes: DM250 is a discontinued 24.5" 10-bit OLED production/reference monitor (part of FSI's DM series alongside DM170/DM240 etc.). Its dedicated product/spec page has been removed from the current flandersscientific.com site (redirects to 404), but the model is still documented in FSI's currently-live, official "Monitor User Manual" PDF (https://flandersscientific.com/support/DMSeriesManual.pdf, fetched directly over verified HTTPS from the manufacturer's own domain, updated 2.3.2026, still lists DM250 in its covered models and gives the full back-panel connector inventory used here). Power-connector types and the precise SDI/DVI/DP input-output counts were cross-verified against Flanders Scientific's original DM250 tech-specs page, preserved by the Internet Archive Wayback Machine (https://web.archive.org/web/20190801000000/http://flandersscientific.com/DM250/tech-specs.php, a snapshot of the manufacturer's own now-removed page) — both sources agree. No rack-mount units were set since the DM250 ships standard with a desktop stand; a rack mount kit is listed only as an optional accessory. The GPI port's exact connector pinout isn't published — it was mapped to rj45 as the closest visual/physical match from the panel photo (same jack style as LAN/RS-485), not confirmed as true 8P8C Ethernet wiring. Grades were omitted for DisplayPort (version unstated) and for the two MON/2nd-monitor BNC outputs (spec table does not explicitly grade them, though they follow whatever input — up to 3G-SDI equivalent — is actively selected). One AI-generated third-party summary (av-iq.com via automated fetch) additionally claimed Component/Composite analog inputs; this was not corroborated by the manufacturer's own tech-specs table or manual and was treated as unreliable/omitted.

ports.name: MON Out 1
ports.note: 2nd-screen/processed monitor output; mirrors the actively selected input (SDI, DisplayPort, or DVI cross-converted); LUT/flip can be applied. Spec sheet does not state an explicit SDI grade for this pair.

ports.name: MON Out 2
ports.note: 2nd-screen/processed monitor output; mirrors the actively selected input; see MON Out 1 note.

ports.name: DVI
ports.note: DVI-D digital input (accepts VGA/NTSC/SVGA/XGA/SXGA analog-equivalent timings and 720p/1440x900/1080p digital per manufacturer format table)

ports.name: DP
ports.note: DisplayPort input; version not specified by manufacturer, grade omitted

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Analog stereo mini-phono, unbalanced; delayed to match video processing latency

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: IP control (FSI IP Remote Utility, Pomfort LiveGrade Pro, etc.)

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: General Purpose Interface for contact-closure remote control, assignable via GPI menu. Physically an RJ45-style modular jack on the panel (matches adjacent LAN/RS-485 jacks) but is NOT an Ethernet port — connector chosen as closest physical match; exact pinout not published.

ports.name: RS-485 Out
ports.note: RS-485 loop-through remote control interface, loops to next device

ports.name: USB Type A
ports.note: USB host port for direct-connect probe alignment; can also power MediaLight bias lights

ports.name: USB Type B
ports.note: USB device port; connects to computer for firmware updates and LUT loading

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 4-pin XLR DC input, 12-24 VDC, ~50W power consumption
